title: Grist cell references are uppercased when creating links
reasoning: The preview lookup uses the user-entered cellRef, and the UI explicitly supports Grist refs such as Amount:1. On submit, the renderer uppercases every ref before sending it to the API. Excel refs tolerate that, but Grist column ids are case-sensitive, so the exact placeholder example previews successfully and then submits AMOUNT:1, causing createLink to target a different or missing cell.
reproduction: Connect a Grist source with a mixed-case column id such as Amount, open Link a value, enter Amount:1, observe the preview, then click Link it. The submitted payload uses AMOUNT:1 instead of Amount:1.
recommendation: Do not uppercase in the renderer. Send the raw cellRef and let the main-side API normalize only Excel-style refs, or apply the same Excel-only /^[A-Za-z]+\d+$/ guard before uppercasing.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature lists no linked tests, and the desktop package test script is an echo. Existing smoke coverage exercises Grist linking through the service layer, not this renderer payload transformation.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a renderer or integration test for AddLinkDialog with a Grist workbook where Amount:1 previews and createLink receives cellRef: "Amount:1" unchanged.
